meta.title: Wuuti: the disposable camera for your parties, as an app
meta.description: Wuuti, the disposable camera app for parties, birthdays, weddings and bachelorette parties: your guests shoot blind, and the shared photo album is revealed the next day.
meta.og: Shoot the night. Discover it tomorrow. Every guest's photos, with no preview, gathered in a shared album that opens the next day.
meta.ogAlt: Wuuti: Shoot the night. Discover it tomorrow. The blind party photo app.
meta.twitter: Shoot the night. Discover it tomorrow.

hero.sub: The party photo app where every guest shoots blind. At each ping, two minutes to take one raw photo. The next day, the vault opens on the shared album of the whole night.
hero.alt: Wuuti party photo app: a ping rings, 1 minute 16 left to take the photo.
notif.text: It's time. You have 2:00.
ritual.title:
Three beats.
One rule: see nothing.
ritual.1.title: It rings.
ritual.1.text: Everyone gets their pings at a different time. Two minutes to draw, front or back camera, no filter.
ritual.1.alt: Wuuti notification: it's time, you have 2 minutes.
ritual.2.title: You shoot. You see nothing.
ritual.2.text: Your photo goes straight to the vault, sealed. So do everyone else's. You live the night instead of watching it on your screen.
ritual.2.alt: Wuuti screen during the party: you're blind, and that's on purpose.
ritual.3.title: The next day, everything opens.
ritual.3.text: At the time the host chose, the vault opens for everyone. Same surprise, same second.
ritual.3.alt: Wuuti screen: the vault is open, 23 photos.
manifesto.title:
You're blind.
It's on purpose.
manifesto.text: With no preview, nobody poses for the photo. You don't check whether you look good in it, you don't scroll through everyone else's shots. You live the night, and the next day, the photo album finally looks like it. Like a disposable camera, minus the film to develop.
vault.sealed: Everyone discovers the album tomorrow at 11:00 AM.
vault.title: The vault is open.
vault.open: Everyone discovers the album at the same time. Nobody cheated, not even the host.
features.title:
Everything for the party.
Nothing to distract from it.
create.title: A room in 30 seconds.

cover.name: Birthday
join.title: Join with a code.

pings.title: Everyone rings at their own time.
live.title: Watch public parties live.
live.text: Strangers watch in real time. The guests themselves stay blind until the vault opens.
live.alt: Wuuti spectator screen: a public live with 214 viewers.
album.alt2: Wuuti album sorted by perspective, photo by photo from each guest.
album.title: One shared album, by hour or by perspective.
album.text: All the guests' photos in one place. Relive the night in order, or through everyone's eyes. Likes and comments, the next day only.
occasions.title:
For every party
that deserves an album.
occ.birthday.title: Birthday
occ.birthday.text: The birthday photos taken by all the guests, not just the one holding the phone. The next day, the gift is the album.
occ.wedding.title: Wedding
occ.wedding.text: The disposable camera on the tables, without the cameras to buy or the film to develop. One QR code, and every guest shoots from their own phone.
occ.evjf.title: Bachelor & bachelorette parties
occ.evjf.text: What happens at the bachelorette party stays in the vault until the next day. And no spectators if the room is private.
occ.weekend.title: Weekend with friends
occ.weekend.text: A room over several days, pings throughout the trip, and one shared album at the end instead of ten conversations.
occ.student.title: Student party
occ.student.text: Housewarming, welcome night, gala: thirty free participants, and nobody spends the night with their nose in the gallery.
occ.nye.title: New Year's Eve
occ.nye.text: The vault opens on January 1st at the time you choose. The year's first surprise, for everyone at once.
pricing.title: Free for most parties.

plan.free.2: One ad when the vault opens
plan.free.3: Raw photos for 30 days, album forever

faq.title: The rules of the game.
faq.1.q: Can I see the photos during the party?
faq.1.a: No. Nobody can, not even the host. The photos stay sealed in the vault until opening time, the next day.
faq.2.q: What if I miss a ping?
faq.2.a: It's gone. No catching up, no photo imported from your gallery. That's what keeps the album honest.
faq.3.q: Who can watch a room live?
faq.3.a: Only public rooms, and never by their own guests. A private room has no spectators.
faq.4.q: Do I need to create an account?
faq.4.a: Yes, an account is required (email and password, Google, Apple or passkey). Your username signs your photos, there's no profile to fill in.
faq.5.q: Can I be in two rooms at once?
faq.5.a: No, one at a time. You're at one party, not three.
faq.6.q: How do I collect all the guests' photos?
faq.6.a: You have nothing to collect. Every photo taken in the room goes straight into the same shared album, which opens for everyone the next day. No more chasing the WhatsApp group.
faq.7.a: That's the spirit: no preview, no editing, and you discover the photos later. Except here, there's no film to develop or camera to hand out: every guest uses their own phone.
faq.8.q: How is it different from BeReal?
faq.8.a: BeReal is one photo a day with your friends. Wuuti is for the length of an event: everyone gets their pings at a different time, nobody sees anything during the party, and everything is revealed at once the next day.
faq.9.q: Does it work for a wedding?
faq.9.a: Yes. Guests join with a QR code on the tables, and the next day you discover the wedding as each of them saw it. Beyond 30 guests, the €0.99 Premium plan opens the room with no limit.
